title.narrative: Rajasthan State Highway Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: The Government of Rajasthan proposed a third tranche amounting to $110 million to cover the improvement of about 290 km of state highways and major district roads. It also supports the capacity building of Rajasthan Public Works Department on implementation of the streamlined business procedures and gender equality and social inclusion. Although the MFF is implemented in three tranches in lieu of original plan of two, the overall impact, outcome, and outputs will be achieved, and implementation arrangements will remain unchanged. The periodic financing request was received on 21 October 2022.

Output: State highways and MDRs improved Indicator: At least four wayside facilities with amenities for livelihood and services for women constructed and maintained (2022 baseline: 0) (OP 1.3.1; OP 2.4.1) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Over achieved. Six wayside facilities, including women's restrooms, lactation rooms, and separate toilet facilities, have been provided. Additionally, an employment target of 50% women has been incorporated under toll agency's contract agreement. Further, an advisory note has been issued to all contractors, encouraging the engagement of women, wherever feasible, in road maintenance and plantation activities.
Data Source: RPWD project progress reports

Output: State highways and MDRs improved Indicator: At least one bus stop with EWCD-responsive features in each of the seven districts constructed (2022 baseline: 0) (OP 1.3.1; OP 2.4.1) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Over achieved. Construction of all 113 bus stops completed all along the complete stretch road. All bus stops integrate most gender-responsive elements such as solar lighting, separate seating provisions, covered roofs, ramps, railings, and clearly displayed emergency contact details, enhancing safety, accessibility, and user comfort. Additionally, to promote safe and hygienic public infrastructure, particularly for women, a total of 26 toilet facilities has been provided.
Data Source: RPWD project progress reports
